explanation: Debug-mode Wasm-GC null traps now receive stack maps at the faulting instruction's resume offset for struct and array access paths. call_ref and return_call_ref propagate the fault offset back to the baseline compiler so the same debug-only map can be registered.
verification: The supplied ASan command runs pocs/probe.js. The parent returns normally after the expected null-reference trap; the edited tree reports the newly introduced memory-safety error during Wasm compilation.
